problem_type: Stale editable focus captures canvas undo
symptom: After manually changing a generation-canvas node model, Cmd+Z/Ctrl+Z leaves the new model selected instead of undoing the model change.
direct_cause: The canvas keydown guard treats an editable document.activeElement as sufficient evidence that the keystroke belongs to text editing, even when the actual key event target is the model picker.
class_root: The shared keyboard boundary has no event-source ownership rule: stale focus is allowed to override the target that emitted the shortcut.
affected_population: Generation Canvas users on macOS using Cmd+Z after model/provider/variant selection
Generation Canvas users on Windows/Linux using Ctrl+Z after model/provider/variant selection
Any generation-canvas shortcut emitted by a non-editable control while an editable element remains focused
entry_points: GenerationCanvasReactFlow installs the shared canvas keydown listener
NodeParameterControls routes manual model, provider, and variant changes through updateNode
internal_only_reason: The invariant is an application-level DOM event ownership rule; no third-party behavior determines the fix.
invariants: A canvas undo shortcut is ignored for text editing only when the actual event target resolves to the focused editable root.
A stale editable activeElement alone cannot suppress a canvas shortcut from a non-editable target.
The canvas shortcut still calls the supplied undo action, which remains the generation-canvas store boundary.
generality_proof: All generation-canvas undo/redo key combinations converge on createCanvasKeydownHandler, while model, provider, and variant selection converge on the same NodeParameterControls model-change write. The target-root rule therefore covers both Meta and Control modifiers and all checked manual model-selection variants without naming a vendor or model.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own editable shortcut ownership by comparing the event target's editable root with the active editable root.
Route the real canvas keydown event to undo/redo only after shared guards pass.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The handler uses event.metaKey and the same editable-root guard; the regression dispatches a Meta+Z event with stale textarea focus.
The handler uses event.ctrlKey and shares the same target/focus guard; the class test covers the same path independent of model identity.
Manual model/provider/variant controls call the same updateNode path, whose existing history boundary already records the meta edit.
Timeline shortcuts have a separate resolver and timeline store; they do not install or call the generation-canvas handler.

recurrence.reason: The stale-focus mechanism is independent of the selected model and can recur for either modifier key or any non-editable canvas control that leaves an editor focused.
same_class_scan: Searched all generation-canvas keydown listeners and confirmed useCanvasShortcuts is the shared canvas undo owner.
Searched model/provider/variant selection and confirmed NodeParameterControls.handleModelChange is the shared manual model write entry.
Checked timelineShortcuts separately and classified it not-affected because it owns a different store and resolver.

prevention.invariant: Editable shortcut ownership requires the key event target to resolve to the current editable root; stale focus alone never blocks canvas shortcuts.
prevention.failure_mode: A non-editable target with stale editable focus falls through to the canvas command; a real event from the editable root returns without preventDefault.
prevention.strategy: Enforce event-source ownership once in the shared canvas keydown guard so every caller and both platform modifiers receive identical behavior.

legacy_paths.rationale: No persisted or callable legacy behavior needs migration; the handler extraction keeps one production keydown path and changes only its shared focus判据.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency controls the application-level event-target and focus ownership invariant.

migration: No persisted data or caller contract changes; existing nodes and undo journal entries remain valid.
residual_risks: The focused component test models stale editable focus explicitly; the real Electron model-picker walk confirmed ordinary model-button focus and undo, but no separate OS-level IME/native-select path was exercised.
